title: Area Manager - (Amazon)
summary: An Area Manager for an Amazon warehouse transitioning to a role at AVS2 Logistics India Pvt. Ltd. in Delhi oversees fast-paced e-commerce warehousing, sorting, and last-mile/reverse logistics operations.  Public Description Results-driven Logistics and Operations Leader transitioning from Amazon Fulfillment/Delivery operations to AVS2 Logistics India Pvt. Ltd. in Delhi. Proven expertise in managing high-volume warehouse floors, sorting centers, safety compliance, and last-mile e-commerce supply chains. Adept at team leadership, KPI optimization, and driving on-time delivery performance across dynamic urban logistics networks.  Key Responsibilities & Highlights to Include • Operations Leadership: Managing daily shift operations, floor staffing, and workflow execution across Amazon/AVS2 sorting and distribution hubs. • Performance & Metrics: Tracking SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance, dispatch accuracy, cost control, and turnaround times. • Safety & Compliance: Enforcing workplace safety protocols, labor standards, and inventory reconciliation. • Stakeholder Management: Coordinating with e-commerce clients (such as Amazon and 3PL partners), transport fleets, and regional business heads.
requirements: • Manage and optimize daily warehouse, sorting, and delivery hub operations. • Lead, mentor, and schedule large teams of floor associates and supervisors. • Track and improve operational KPIs, including SLA compliance, dispatch accuracy, and turnaround times. • Coordinate seamless handoffs between inbound processing, sorting, and last-mile delivery networks. • Enforce strict workplace safety standards, labor law compliance, and 5S protocols. • Minimize operational costs while maximizing daily processing and package throughput. • Resolve real-time supply chain bottlenecks, transport delays, and system glitches. • Maintain high inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts and audit compliance. • Collaborate closely with client account managers, fleet operators, and regional headers. • Analyze shift data and performance metrics to implement continuous process improvements.
